name: The King in Yellow
title: Lord of Lost Carcosa
description: A play is going around. It has two acts. Everyone who reads the first act wants to read the second, and everyone who reads the second act is changed. They see a city by a cloudy lake under twin suns, and they hear a King calling them home.
rules_text: Each Night, the investigator with the lowest Sanity tests Nerve (-1) or gains Night Terrors.
An extra Pallid Mask drifts through the world.

effects.text: Someone hums a tune from the play.

rites.name: Burn Every Copy
rites.text: Spend Funds in any city to buy up the play and burn it. 3 per investigator.

rites.name: Survive the Second Act
rites.text: Test Nerve in Paris, where the play is staged. 2 successes per investigator.

rites.name: Close the Road to Carcosa
rites.text: Seal rifts anywhere. 1 per investigator.

rites.name: Lay the Phantom to Rest
rites.text: Defeat the Phantom of Truth, which waits in Prague.

rites.name: Read the Reflections
rites.text: Spend Clues on the Tibetan Plateau, where the high lakes show Carcosa's sky. 2 per investigator.

awakening.text: Twin suns rise over a lake of cloud, and the King removes his mask. There is no mask. Everyone who has read the play rises from their beds and walks toward the nearest water. You have three nights to write a different ending.

final_rite.name: Write the Third Act
final_rite.text: Test Lore in any city to write an ending the King cannot bear. 3 successes per investigator.

name: Cthulhu
title: The Dreamer Beneath the Waves
description: In a drowned city at the bottom of the South Pacific, a vast thing lies dead but dreaming. Its dreams leak into the minds of artists, madmen, and sailors. When the stars come right, the city will rise, and the dreamer will wake.
rules_text: Each Night, every investigator at sea tests Nerve or loses 1 Sanity.
Extra Drowned Ones and Tide Crawlers lurk in the monster pool.

rites.name: Chart the Dreaming Currents
rites.text: Spend Clues at sea, where the dreams are strongest. 2 per investigator.

rites.name: Wake the Sleepers
rites.text: Test Charm in Rio de Janeiro or Yokohama to talk the dreamers out of their trance. 2 successes per investigator.

rites.name: Seal the Wet Gates
rites.text: Seal rifts anywhere. 1 per investigator.

rites.name: Slay the Herald
rites.text: Defeat the Spawn of the Deep, which waits in the North Pacific.

rites.name: Return the Idol to the Sea
rites.text: Offer a relic at sea.

awakening.text: The stars are right. A city of green stone rises from the South Pacific, and its doors swing open. The dreamer wakes. You have four nights to sing it back to sleep.

final_rite.name: Sing the City Down
final_rite.text: Test Lore in the South Pacific, in the shadow of the risen city. 3 successes per investigator.

name: Yog-Sothoth
title: The Key and the Gate
description: Yog-Sothoth does not live behind a door. It is the door, and every door. It touches all places and all times at once, and sorcerers who call it never call it twice. Rifts open more often now, because something on the other side is pushing.
rules_text: Each Night, something may push through a rift from the other side.
If 8 rifts are open at once, the investigators lose.

outcomes.text: Something pushes through from the other side.

rites.name: Close the Doors
rites.text: Seal rifts anywhere. 1 per investigator.

rites.name: Lay the Broken Seals
rites.text: Spend 2 Trophies in the Empty Quarter, at the nameless city.

rites.name: Recite the Reversed Formula
rites.text: Test Lore (-1) in Providence or Prague. 2 successes per investigator.

rites.name: Banish the Unseen Twin
rites.text: Defeat the Unseen Twin, which starts in the Yukon Wilds and hunts investigators.

rites.name: Gather the Scattered Pages
rites.text: Spend Clues in Europe. 2 per investigator.

awakening.text: Every rift on Earth flares at once. Through them all you see the same thing: a mass of shining spheres, pressing closer. Yog-Sothoth is here, and it is everywhere. Lock the doors before it steps through.

final_rite.name: Lock Every Door
final_rite.text: Seal rifts anywhere while the doors burn open. 1 per investigator.

name: Nyarlathotep
title: The Crawling Chaos
description: He came out of Egypt, they say, tall and dark and smiling, and gave lectures on electricity and the stars. Crowds followed him. Cities went mad after he left. He is the messenger of older gods, and he wears a thousand faces. Some of those faces belong to people you trust.
rules_text: -1 Charm for every investigator. No one can be trusted.
Each Night, the investigator with the most Clues tests Wits or loses 1 Clue to his agents.
Each Night, a Masked Acolyte may appear. Extra Acolytes walk among the crowds.

effects.text: A friendly stranger buys you a drink and asks about your work.

outcomes.text: A smiling stranger in a porcelain mask steps off a train.

rites.name: Unmask the Stranger
rites.text: Defeat the Smiling Stranger, who starts in Cairo and hunts investigators.

rites.name: Expose the Cult
rites.text: Test Charm in a hub city (Providence, Rio, Paris, Cairo, Bombay, or Peking). 3 successes per investigator.

rites.name: Follow His Footsteps
rites.text: Spend Clues anywhere in Africa. 2 per investigator.

rites.name: Buy Back the Lecture Notes
rites.text: Spend Funds in New York or Paris. 4 per investigator.

rites.name: Return the Stolen Relic
rites.text: Offer a relic in Cairo.

awakening.text: Every face in every crowd turns toward you at once, and every one of them is smiling. The Crawling Chaos has dropped its masks. You have four nights before the world forgets it was ever sane.

final_rite.name: Stare Down the Thousand Faces
final_rite.text: Test Nerve in Cairo, where he first appeared. 3 successes per investigator.
